pages.title: Yesterday Was Colder
pages.text: Reach the third ancient expedition environment.

pages.title: Getting started
pages.text: Prepare a return route and appropriate supplies before using its portal. Look for manganese as a practical next project; mining it is not part of this visit task. Cold fauna have separate equipment and riding rules: Froststalker Helmet and Tusklin should be studied as distinct options, not universal

pages.title: How it works
pages.text: Explore Paleogene, Neogene and Pleistocene eras. Formations are biome-like regions within each dimension. Content scope is three dimensions, not two.
